scope: All 135 MC and 80 mock objective questions, plus 20 mock O/X statements. Written/OX banks retain previously checked content.
reviewCriteria: Length and parallel construction in both directions, including a uniquely long false option
Plausible neighboring concepts and identifiable calculation/analysis errors
Unique single answer and exact multi-answer set under all given conditions
R call syntax, interpretation, and formula units
Option-specific explanations and full-credit/zero-credit grading; O/X one point per statement
Stable identifiers/order/answer sets, source/mock synchronization, and concept coverage

independentFinding.issue: A false alternative could be read as true for the supplied proportional scaling case.
independentFinding.resolution: Explicitly states the incorrect generalization to changed D/W in the choice itself; updated its rationale and mock copy.

retainedItemsRationale: 55 unedited MC items mainly test numerical results, formula forms, or matched classifications. Existing distractors encode neighboring categories, intermediate values, reversals, unit mistakes or alternative results. They were reviewed without padding options to equal character counts.
RVerification: 18 displayed R call alternatives parse in actual R 4.6.0. Incorrect choices remain syntactically valid while differing in target data, parameters, model direction or plotting attributes. Existing 40 model-code execution cases are unchanged.
grading: Standalone MC requires exact correct option set. Mock single/multi earns 2 or 0 points; a two-statement O/X block awards 1 per correctly classified statement. Five sets retain 32 items and 100 points each.

lengthHeuristic.method: Mean normalized correct-option length / mean incorrect-option length; skip minimal numerical/code outputs under 15 normalized characters. This is a screening aid, not evidence of empirical discrimination.

limitations: No original-exam access or student-response data. This review does not claim measured item difficulty/discrimination. Probability distributions, source data, formulas, units and conditions necessary to solve each question remain visible.
